explanation: arXiv:2506.23631 §4.2: 'Let Ω ⊂ ℝ be a finite union of three or more intervals. If Ω weakly tiles its complement, must it also tile properly?' The formal statement: for n ≥ 3 strictly separated intervals and any weak tiling measure ν, there is T with Σ_{t∈T} δ_t a weak tiling measure, i.e. a proper tiling of the complement. Faithful.
